analytics.name: Analytic 1816
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Bidirectional Communication by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: Local file write between inbound retrieval]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Apps approved for bidirectional use of each platform: note-taking app for its own cloud, email app for its service. Non-platform apps doing read-then-write cycles are anomalous.
Default 120s between inbound retrieval and outbound write constituting one C2 cycle. Tightening: 30s.
Default 3 retrieve-write cycles within $ObservationWindow$. Single cycle may be legitimate; repeated cycles are C2 pattern.

log_sources.name: android:EMM
log_sources.channel: Managed package inventory/status and package metadata

log_sources.channel: Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: Local file write between inbound retrieval

log_sources.channel: DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: Background scheduler or persistent service triggers retrieve-then-write cycle
